meta.name: alfworld-appliance-navigator
meta.description: Navigates the agent to a target appliance (microwave, stove, fridge, or sinkbasin) needed for object processing. Use when you are holding an object that needs heating, cooling, or cleaning and must move to the correct appliance station. Identifies the required appliance from the task context and executes the movement action.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动导航到目标家电完成物品处理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在虚拟环境中需要自动移动到微波炉、冰箱等家电旁处理物品。
copy.tagline_en: Navigate to target appliance for object processing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically move to an appliance like microwave or fridge in a virtual environment.

howto.what: 当你拿着需要加热、冷却或清洗的物品时，Claude 会自动识别目标电器（微波炉、灶台、冰箱或水槽），移动到该电器，并先打开关闭的门。
howto.when: 当你拿着物品且下一步任务需要加热、冷却或清洗它时触发。

say.text: 我需要加热这个土豆，带我找微波炉。
say.note: 会导航到微波炉并打开门。

say.text: 把这块肉放到冰箱里冷藏。
帮我清洗这个盘子，带我去水槽。

howto.what_en: When you hold an object that needs heating, cooling, or cleaning, Claude automatically identifies the required appliance (microwave, stove, fridge, or sinkbasin), moves to it, and opens any closed door before use.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are holding an object and the next task step is to heat, cool, or clean it.

say_en.text: I need to heat this potato, take me to the microwave.
say_en.note: Navigates to microwave and opens door.

say_en.text: Put this meat in the fridge to cool.
say_en.note: Navigates to fridge and opens door.

say_en.text: Clean this plate, take me to the sinkbasin.
